name: juraj-skills
description: Agent skills for planning, building, verifying, and reviewing code.

metadata.description: Agent skills for planning, building, verifying, and reviewing code.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Every skill in this marketplace, including the pmode router. Install this or individual skills, not both.

plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Use when writing, editing, or reviewing comments in code, including doc comments and lint suppressions.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Use when asked to review a PR, branch diff, or local changes, or before merging or handing off your own work.

plugins.name: commit-rules
plugins.description: Use when committing, writing commit messages, splitting work into commits, pushing, or resolving merge or rebase conflicts.

plugins.name: core-principles
plugins.description: Use when planning, designing, refactoring, or reviewing code, when judging a diff's size or structure, when you are torn between two options, or when the user says to apply core engineering principles (or rules, values) or names one.

plugins.name: create-verification-skill
plugins.description: Use when the user invokes create-verification-skill, or asks to create, audit, or update a project verification skill.

plugins.name: diagnose-bug
plugins.description: Use when the user says "diagnose" or "debug this", or reports something broken, throwing, failing, flaky, or slow whose cause isn't obvious.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless interview to sharpen a plan, decision, or design until every branch is resolved. Use when the user invokes grill-me or asks to be grilled.

plugins.name: improve-codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Use when asked to improve, review, or find refactoring opportunities in a codebase's architecture or structure, not a single diff.

plugins.name: improve-codebase-docs
plugins.description: Use when asked to improve, audit, or reorganize a repo's docs, agent instruction files, or glossary, or when deciding whether a design or product decision is worth recording.

plugins.name: improve-codebase-guardrails
plugins.description: Use when asked to add or improve linters, type checks, import rules, CI checks, or tests that guard a codebase, or after a mistake or review correction that shouldn't happen again.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Use when running long or multi-step work, delegating to subagents or parallel agents, working autonomously while the user is away, or resuming after context compaction.

plugins.name: pmode
plugins.description: Load this first, before any other skill (including diagnose-bug and tdd) and before reading or searching code, whenever a conversation opens with a coding task, such as an issue, ticket, bug report, pasted error, failing or flaky test, a feature the user wants ("I want to add X"), or a request to build, add, change, fix, or refactor something. Skip for questions and trivial edits (typo, config value, dependency bump). Also when the user invokes pmode.

plugins.name: pr-comments
plugins.description: Use when replying to or resolving PR review comments, addressing review feedback, or staging/drafting PR review comments without posting them.

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Use when the user invokes show-me or asks to see the current topic as a diagram, code-shape sketch, or visual explanation.

plugins.name: stage-pr
plugins.description: Open a draft pull request for current work or branch. Iterate until CI is green and Copilot review approves. Use when the user asks to stage a PR or make a PR reviewable or ready for review.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Use when building a feature or fixing a bug test-first, when asked for red-green-refactor, a failing test, or a regression test, when writing or changing tests, and when asked to audit, review, or evaluate test coverage or test quality.

plugins.name: to-spec
plugins.description: Use when the user invokes to-spec or asks to write a spec from the current conversation.

plugins.name: to-tickets
plugins.description: Use when the user invokes to-tickets or asks to break a spec or plan into tickets.

plugins.name: verify-with-proof
plugins.description: Use after implementing, before claiming work is done, fixed, or passing, and when asked to "verify", "prove it works", or "did this fix it".

plugins.name: visual-pr-description
plugins.description: Create or update a GitHub pull request description with a compact visual change outline. Use when writing or updating the description of the user's own PR.

plugins.name: write-agent-skill
plugins.description: Use when writing, editing, or reviewing agent skills.

plugins.name: write-well
plugins.description: Always apply. Use whenever writing or editing prose, docs, comments, commit messages, PR descriptions, or composing chat responses.
